callees.name: self._console.flush
callees.pre_condition: The console stream is open and may contain buffered data written by prior write calls.
callees.post_condition: All buffered data in the console stream is committed to the underlying device.

callees.name: self._log_stream.flush
callees.pre_condition: The log stream is open (not closed) and may contain buffered data written by prior write calls.
callees.post_condition: All buffered data in the log stream is committed to the underlying file.
